tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App background (bg-background): page, sidebar inset. Text on it is foreground.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text (text-foreground) on background, card, popover, surface, muted, accent, selected (≥ 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surfaces that hold one object: Card, tables, form sections, settings sections.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: Popover, DropdownMenu, Select/Combobox lists, Dialog, Sheet, Sonner toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand/action colour: default Button, links (text-primary), checked controls, progress, focus-adjacent accents. As text on background, card and surface ≥ 6:1.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (≥ 6.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Filled neutral button (variant secondary) — used sparingly; the everyday secondary action is variant outline.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Neutral fills: skeletons, TabsList (default variant), progress track, avatar fallback, count pills.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting text: descriptions, helper text, table headers, captions, placeholders, inactive tabs. On background, card, surface, muted, selected (≥ 5.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover/highlight fill: ghost and outline buttons, menu items, list rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: destructive Button fill, error text/icons, invalid borders. As text on card and destructive-muted ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill (≥ 6.5:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default borders: cards, tables, separators, popovers (decorative, no contrast minimum).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of form controls and outline buttons — ≥ 3:1 on card and background in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring (ring-2 ring-ring) — ≥ 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Keel: recessed zone inside a card — table header row, card footer, filter bar, code blocks. (Same name shadcn's own site uses.)

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Keel: selected table rows (data-[state=selected]:bg-selected), chosen list options. Text on it is foreground.

tokens.name: destructive-muted
tokens.usage: Keel: tinted background for destructive Badges and Alerts.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Keel: success text/icons (paid, active, done). On card and success-muted ≥ 4.5:1. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Keel: text on a success fill.

tokens.name: success-muted
tokens.usage: Keel: tinted background for success Badges and Alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Keel: warning text/icons (pending, needs attention). On card and warning-muted ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Keel: text on a warning fill.

tokens.name: warning-muted
tokens.usage: Keel: tinted background for warning Badges and Alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Keel: informational text/icons (scheduled, in progress). On card and info-muted ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Keel: text on an info fill.

tokens.name: info-muted
tokens.usage: Keel: tinted background for info Badges and Alerts.

families.ui: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.code: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight — onboarding, empty-account and auth headlines only.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: text-base font-semibold — CardTitle, section and dialog titles (h2).

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: text-sm font-semibold — titles inside a section, sidebar group labels (h3).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: text-sm — default product text: cells, inputs, menus, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: text-sm font-medium — Label, FieldLabel, buttons, table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: text-xs text-muted-foreground — timestamps, counts, badges (medium). The floor size.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: text-xs font-mono — IDs and keys inline; text-sm font-mono for code blocks.

spacing.note: Tailwind's default spacing (0.25rem steps). These are the steps Keel layouts use.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: gap-1: icon to label; label to control

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: gap-1.5: field label → control → description (shadcn Field)

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: gap-2: buttons in a group, badges, inline items; Stack gap="xs"

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: gap-3: toolbar items; table cell padding (px-3)

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: p-4 / gap-4: card padding, gap between fields and cards (Stack gap="md"), mobile gutter

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: gap-6 / px-6: page sections (Stack gap="lg"), desktop gutter

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: gap-8: settings groups (Stack gap="xl")

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: py-12: empty states, onboarding rhythm

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: pt-16: auth and error page offset

radius.note: shadcn convention: one --radius; Tailwind derives rounded-sm (×0.6), rounded-md (×0.8), rounded-lg (×1), rounded-xl (×1.4).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius (8px): cards and popovers use rounded-lg; buttons and inputs rounded-md (≈6px); badges rounded-md; dialogs rounded-xl.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: size="sm" buttons, filter-bar inputs, table actions (h-8)

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default Button, Input, SelectTrigger (h-9) — shadcn's default

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: size="lg": auth, onboarding, touch layouts (h-10)

tokens.name: layout-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width (shadcn SIDEBAR_WIDTH, 256px).

tokens.name: layout-header
tokens.usage: Site header height inside SidebarInset (h-12).

tokens.name: layout-aside
tokens.usage: Detail page aside column; settings nav column is 220px.

tokens.name: layout-sheet
tokens.usage: Default Sheet width on desktop (sm:max-w-[480px]).

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Create/edit forms, onboarding, error pages (max-w-3xl ≈ 768 is acceptable).

tokens.name: container-default
tokens.usage: Detail pages and settings.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Index pages and dashboards.

tokens.name: container-auth
tokens.usage: Sign in / sign up card.
